translation.name: Jesucristo oy oa’pak: Kenda Jesucristoa; monigka’uyatenok; Diostaj mo’manopo’yarea’ika’ne

book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: SAN MARCOS Marcosa Jesucristoen huadak huaʼa oʼmanigmadoyaʼuyate.

content: Huabokerektaj huakkaʼada totoʼ noki̱re̱ga̱ onʼnopoʼto̱e̱ʼuyate.
Ken akodpen Gadara huadaribayo oʼbetatoʼuyate.
Jesús eʼkotdeʼte kubarakbayaʼ nogbokerektida oʼhuatiakuyate. Kentaj dakhueʼda noki̱re̱ga̱ oʼnopoʼtounhuahuikaʼuyate.
Kubarakbayo oʼnoikaʼuyate. Kentaj sirobijtoneʼa̱ tinukuhueʼdik o̱ʼnuyate.
Nogok nogok sirobijtoneʼa̱ huabaʼtaʼkoypiʼ kenpaʼti huaʼitakpi onʼtinukuʼeaʼnigʼa teyda o̱ʼe̱po sirobijtoneʼtaj oʼtipukpukikaʼ kenpaʼti oʼbakpukikaʼuyate. Kentaj to̱e̱hueʼdik o̱ʼnuyate.
Huameʼnoe kenpaʼti sikyo oʼhuaʼepo oteʼyo kenpaʼti kubarakyaʼ oʼsagkiaʼikaʼpo huida̱ huataʼ oʼbitakpo oʼayagsikatokaʼpo oʼkikaʼuyate.
Jesústaj oʼtiahuaypo huikudate oʼtisakotuyate.

—‍Ken huabokerektaj yako̱ro̱k, dakhueʼda noki̱re̱g. —‍Jesúsa onaʼnok huabokereka ʼuttaʼda oaʼtokpo: —‍¿Menaʼpo doʼtaj oʼhuatiak, Jesús? Dios kutayo hua̱e̱ʼerien Huasiʼpo i̱ʼe̱ne. Diosa beʼtihuapokeʼ kenpaʼda castiga o̱gkahueʼ meeʼ. —‍Jesústaj ʼuttaʼda onaʼuyate.
—‍¿Katedik i̱ʼe̱? —‍Jesúsa onaʼuy. Huakkaʼda noki̱re̱g o̱ʼnenok, —‍Doʼhued huadik o̱ʼe̱ “Huakkaʼ,”
adyonda oroʼtaj taʼmonahueʼ moeʼ. —‍Jesústaj diga̱ʼ oʼnonaʼuyate.
Kente oteʼte huakkaʼda huakyariʼ onʼpeʼnok,
—‍Huakyariere a̱ʼe̱ya̱ʼpo yanʼkud, oroʼtaj yamanaʼ. —‍Jesústaj dakhueʼda noki̱re̱ga̱ oʼnonaʼnok,
—‍Yanʼkud. —‍Jesúsa eʼmanaʼte noki̱re̱ga̱ huabokerektaj oʼnenonpo dos mil huakyaritaj onʼhuankudonnok ayaʼda huaduk onʼbahuarakpo kubogyo onʼbaajpo e̱ʼpo̱gyo̱ onʼbataʼkoʼtuyate.

Huakyariʼ huamato̱e̱ʼeriomeya̱ kenda onʼtiahuaydepo onʼmepukeʼpo aʼmanbatiaʼpakyaʼpo huakkaʼ jakyo onʼbakeʼtuyate. Taʼbayo kenpaʼti aʼmanbatiaʼpakyaʼpo onʼhuaʼuyate. Kenda Jesúsa oʼkaʼ onʼpe̱e̱depo Jesústaj onʼhuahuaʼpo

oʼnokye̱po ken huabokerektaj huakkaʼ dakhueʼda noki̱re̱ga̱ huaboaʼda enʼmaoro̱kondeʼ onʼtiahuayʼuyate. Ken huabokereka dakaʼ eʼhuadpo yudtaj oʼotpo huadakda o̱ʼe̱po huadakda oʼnopo̱e̱po. Kentaj onʼtiahuaydepo onʼmeʼpukuyate.

Aratbut ke̱yo̱ Jesúsere e̱ʼhua̱e̱a̱ onʼtiahuaydepo kenda Jesúsa oʼkaʼde eatiahuayʼa huakkaʼ jakyo hua̱e̱ʼeritaj onʼmanbatiaʼpakpo, Jesúsa dakhueʼda noki̱re̱gtaj oʼmaoro̱kaʼde kenpaʼti huakyariyo enʼhuankudondeʼte huakyariʼ huaduk onʼbahuarakpo e̱ʼpo̱gyo̱ onʼbataʼkotnig onʼmanbatiaʼpakuyate.
Kenda onʼpe̱e̱depo “Oroʼenbayaʼ yahuadeʼ.” Jesústaj diga̱ʼda oʼnonaʼuyate.
Jesús kusiʼpetoneʼyo aʼhuayaʼpo eʼhuaddeʼte ken huabokerekyaʼ dakhueʼda noki̱re̱g oko̱ro̱kaʼniga̱ “onere eʼhuaʼtaʼ ijpaki,” Jesústaj onaʼnok,
—‍Doere huahueʼ ya̱e̱ʼ. O̱ʼnen jakyo yahuatiʼ. O̱ʼnen huabettaj yamanbatiaʼpak. “Dios Huairi meʼtinepahuiʼpo beʼyareaʼdene.” Dakaʼ yamanbatiaʼpaktiʼ. —‍Jesúsa ken huabokerektaj onaʼuyate.

Ken huabokereka aʼmanbatiaʼpakhuayaʼpo oʼhuaʼpo Decápolis huadaribayo huakkaʼ jakyo huaboaʼda oʼmanbatiaʼpakonhuahuaʼpo “Jesúsa dakhueʼda noki̱re̱gtaj mekmaenameʼne, beʼyareameʼne,” oʼmanbatiaʼpakonhuahuaʼuyate. Ayaʼada onʼpe̱e̱depo “Kenpihuay, ʼurunanada Jesús Huairia oʼkameʼte,” onʼbatiaʼpakuyate.
Jairoen hua̱yo̱butaj oʼnoyhuada̱ʼuyate. Kenpaʼti ettoneʼ Jesúsen yudtaj oʼnejdepo oʼyarudʼuyate.
Onteʼti akodpen kusiʼpetoneʼyo Jesús eʼkumejdeʼte aktaʼbogpete huakkaʼada aratbuta onʼtikupopakuyate.
Jairo judíoen hua̱i̱takeʼ jak huairi o̱ʼu̱yate. Jesústaj oʼhuatiakpo oʼtiahuaydepo huaʼite huikudate oʼtisakotpo,
—‍Doʼhued huayetsiʼpo huabueydikte meke̱ne. Betayareʼpo kanoeʼpo huabaʼa beʼtatibataʼtepo doere bohuaʼ. —‍Jesústaj diga̱ʼda onaʼuyatenok.
Jairoere Jesús oʼhuaʼuyate. Eʼhuaʼte huakkaʼada onʼtahuaʼpo aratbutpoyaʼ aʼdayaʼpo oʼnogkaʼuyate.
Huakkaʼ aratbut e̱gkupopakyo ettoneʼ o̱ʼe̱po dakhueʼda o̱ʼe̱po doce huabayok oʼtipokde mimi batikhueʼ o̱ʼunhuahuikaʼuyate.
Nogtaj nogtaj huamadakkaʼeritaj oʼbahuahuaeʼikaʼuynigʼa ayaʼda keʼnen huakupe eʼyoktada yareahueʼ o̱ʼe̱po nogi̱ti nogi̱ti oʼdakhueʼpakikaʼuyate.
Jesúsa huakkaʼtada oʼbayareaʼikaʼ aratbuta onʼbatiaʼpaknok oʼpe̱e̱depo Jesústaʼpiyen oʼhuatiakpo e̱gkupopakyo Jesúsen yudtaj oʼnejpo,
“Keʼnen yudtaj eʼnejnayo ijyareapoy.” Huanopoʼada oʼnopo̱e̱po,
oʼnejpo mimi oʼbatikonpo “ijyarudi” oʼnopo̱e̱ʼuyate.
Betapiʼ huaboaʼda ijyareadi Jesúsa oʼnopo̱e̱po huakkaʼ aratbutyo huataʼpiyon oʼkorudpo, —‍¿Beʼa meʼnej? —‍Oʼmanaʼnok.
—‍Huakkaʼada aratbutpoyaʼ mondaʼene aʼdayaʼpo mogkaʼne. “¿Beʼa meʼnej?” ¿Menaʼpo iaʼ? —‍Jesúsen huanigpe̱i̱kaʼeria oʼnonaʼuyate.
Jesúsanayo beʼa meʼnejne oʼnopo̱e̱po oʼtiokpokubereʼuyate.
Ken Jesúsa beʼyareadne ettoneʼa̱ oʼnopo̱e̱depo diga̱ʼda oʼmeʼpukpo Jesústaj oʼhuahuaʼpo huaʼite huikudate oʼtisakotpo, “oʼnejne i̱dada ijyarudi,” Jesústaj buttida onaʼuyate.
—‍Doʼtaj oknopo̱e̱nok oʼyareaddene. Dakda i̱ʼe̱po dakaʼda yahuatiʼ, sion. —‍Jesúsa onaʼuyate.
Jesúsa ettoneʼtaj eʼbatiaʼpakte Jairoen jakyaʼ huabokerekakon o̱kye̱yakpo, —‍O̱ʼnen huayetsiʼpo oʼbueyde. Huamanmadikaʼeritaj totiakhueʼ ya̱e̱ʼ. —‍Jairotaj oʼnonaʼuyate.
Jesúsanayo kenda oʼpe̱e̱po nigpe̱e̱hueʼ o̱ʼe̱po, —‍Meʼpukhueʼ ya̱e̱ʼ. Doʼhua oʼyareaʼapo meknopo̱e̱ʼ. —‍Jesúsa Jairotaj onaʼuyate.
—‍Pedro Jacobo Juanereyoʼda do Jairoere huaʼdik o̱ʼne. —‍Oʼmanaʼpo oʼhuaʼpo
huairien jakyo o̱kye̱yakdepo huakkaʼ aratbuttaj oʼbatiahuayʼuyate. Ettoneʼsiʼpo eʼbueytaʼ diga̱ʼda onʼbahuikpo onʼsagkiaʼuyate.
Oʼkuddepo, —‍Menaʼpo boʼsagkiaʼpo diga̱ʼda moʼbahuik. Ettoneʼsiʼpo bueyhueʼ o̱ʼe̱. Oʼtaypo o̱ʼe̱. —‍Jesúsa oʼmanaʼnok,
Jesústaj onʼtierikuynigʼa ayaʼtada oʼmaoro̱kaʼdepo ettoneʼsiʼpoen huaoj hua̱ye̱ keʼnen huatahuaʼeretere ettoneʼsiʼpobuey eʼhuedyo oʼbatokudpo,
muneʼyoen huabaʼtaʼ oʼbaʼpadpo, —‍“Talita, cumi.” Yaboʼ, muneʼyo̱siʼpo, onaʼne. —‍Jesúsa onaʼuyate.
I̱dada muneʼyo̱siʼpo oʼbodpo oʼhuaeʼuyate. Doce huabayok oʼto̱e̱ʼuyate. Diga̱ʼda onʼmepukeʼpo “kenpihuay” o̱daʼuyate.
“Ken boʼtiahuaynig betapiʼ manbatiaʼpakhueʼ yaneʼ.” I̱ghuaʼda oʼmanaʼpo, “muneʼyo̱siʼpotaj aypopiʼ yanʼyok,” oʼmanaʼuyate.
